channel.title: JPCERT/CC — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by JPCERT/CC (jpcert).

item.title: CVE-2026-129544 · 5.9 MEDIUM
item.description: Zoraxy provided by Zoraxy Project does not add HttpOnly attribute to session cookies that allows an attacker to retrieve session cookies via a script executed on the browser.

item.title: CVE-2026-105304 · 8.6 HIGH
item.description: ACME challenge routing logic of Zoraxy fails to validate request URIs properly, that allows an attacker to send an arbitrary request to a service on the internal network.

item.title: CVE-2026-105303 · 6.1 MEDIUM
item.description: The log viewer of Zoraxy admin panel fails to neutralize the output properly, that may cause an arbitrary script to be executed on the administrator's browser.

item.title: CVE-2026-113347 · 8.6 HIGH

item.description: A cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in Win Bird JYUGYO SHIEN browser extensions for Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge, which allows an attacker to execute arbitrary script in the user's web browser.

item.description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary OS commands with the privileges of the application.
